description: 1. The agent must read the skill's SKILL.md and navigate to ~/contracts/drafting/ as the correct location for active drafts. 2. It must create the ~/contracts/drafting/webapp-dev-agreement/ directory and populate all five required files: current.md, intake.md, parties.md, notes.md, and versions/v001.md. 3. The proprietary version control trap: the agent must NEVER just create current.md alone — it must copy the draft into versions/v001.md first, then set current.md to that content. 4. Every draft file (both current.md and v001.md) must contain the exact mandatory AI disclaimer: 'generated by AI', 'does NOT constitute legal advice', 'licensed attorney'. 5. intake.md must contain completed discovery answers covering client identity, payment, deliverables, and other services-agreement questions from intake.md. 6. parties.md must list both the developer and the client with their interests/roles. 7. notes.md must contain substantive risk analysis (scope creep, IP ownership, liability cap, payment default) — not just the original stub text. 8. current.md must include all mandatory sections for a services agreement: Scope of Work, Compensation/Payment, Intellectual Property, Termination, Governing Law, Limitation of Liability. 9. The agent must NOT modify the unrelated nda-vendor-2023 draft directory.
